summary: The home page has no skip link: the header is the first element of the body (the other pages start with a link to the main content). RGAA requires this link; under WCAG alone the landmarks could be argued to satisfy the criterion.
fixed_by: The first element of the body is a link to the main content that becomes visible on focus.

summary: The picture of the library in the news list is an informative image with no alt attribute.
fixed_by: The image has an alt attribute in French that describes the drawing.

summary: A purely decorative pictogram placed before a card heading has the text alternative "pictogramme document", which adds noise before the heading.
fixed_by: The decorative pictogram has an empty alt attribute.

summary: The publication dates of the news items are grey (#9aa3a8) on white, a contrast ratio of about 2.6:1 for normal-size text.
fixed_by: Dates use #4d5961, about 7.2:1 on white.

summary: The welcome message for foreign visitors is in English inside a French page and has no lang attribute.
fixed_by: The English paragraph has lang="en".

summary: The page title "Bienvenue à Valmont-sur-Aure" is a paragraph styled to look like a heading: the page has no h1 and its heading outline starts at level 2.
fixed_by: The page title is the single h1 of the page.

summary: The news list is a ul whose direct children are div elements instead of li elements.
fixed_by: Each news item is an li element.

summary: The three links of the "Démarches et services" cards have their focus outline removed and show no other focus indicator.
fixed_by: The links keep the site-wide 3px focus outline.

summary: The telephone link contains only an image with an empty alt attribute, so it has no accessible name; the number itself is plain text outside the link.
fixed_by: The link text is the telephone number; the pictogram stays decorative, outside the link.

summary: The information banner has a fixed height of 4.5rem with hidden overflow: at 200 % zoom, or in a narrow window, its text wraps onto more lines and the end of the message is cut off.
fixed_by: The banner has no fixed height and grows with its text.

summary: The "En bref" news line is a marquee element: the text scrolls continuously and cannot be paused or stopped.
fixed_by: The same text is a static paragraph.

summary: To follow a request the user must type the 2nd and 5th characters of the tracking code: a memory and transcription test that a password manager or copy and paste cannot complete, with no other way to authenticate.
fixed_by: One password field takes the whole tracking code, accepts paste and has autocomplete="current-password".

summary: The breadcrumb navigation is named with aria-labelledby="titre-fil", an id that does not exist, so the landmark has no accessible name and cannot be told apart from the main menu by name.
fixed_by: The breadcrumb navigation has aria-label="Fil d’Ariane".

summary: The form announces a 15-minute session limit; when it is reached a script erases everything typed and returns to step 1, with no warning beforehand and no way to turn off, adjust or extend the limit.
fixed_by: The form has no time limit.

summary: In the list of steps the current step differs from the others by its text colour only (teal instead of grey, about 1.1:1 between the two), and the step headings no longer state "Étape n sur 4" (the h2 of each step is shortened as part of this defect).
fixed_by: The current step has aria-current="step", bold text, an underline bar and the words "(en cours)"; each step heading starts with "Étape n sur 4".

summary: When a step is submitted with missing or invalid values, the only feedback is a generic sentence, "Le formulaire contient des erreurs.": the fields in error are not identified, no message is attached to them, and the sentence is neither focused nor announced.
fixed_by: Each error is written as text next to its field and linked with aria-describedby and aria-invalid; an error summary with one link per field receives focus.

summary: After "Continuer" (or "Étape précédente") the step that held the focused button is hidden and nothing takes focus: focus falls back to the top of the document and the new step is not announced.
fixed_by: On each step change, focus moves to the heading of the step now displayed, and the page title is updated.

summary: The fieldset that groups the three "Type d’acte" radio buttons has no legend; the question is a plain paragraph.
fixed_by: The question is the legend of the fieldset.

summary: The "Nom de naissance" field (step 2) has no programmatic label: the label element before it has no for attribute and does not wrap the input.
fixed_by: The label has for="nom".

summary: The date of birth is entered in three fields (day, month, year) with no indication of the expected format, such as an example or the number of digits for the year.
fixed_by: An example ("Par exemple : 27 3 1985") is shown under the legend and linked to the group with aria-describedby; the error message repeats it.

summary: The requester's first-name field in step 3 reuses the id "prenom" already used in step 2: the id is duplicated and the step 3 label points to the step 2 field, leaving this field without a label.
fixed_by: The field has its own id, "demandeur-prenom", and its label points to it.

summary: The field for the requester's own email address has no autocomplete attribute.
fixed_by: The field has autocomplete="email".

summary: The identity document is uploaded through a div with an inline click handler while the real file input is hidden with display:none: the required upload cannot be reached or operated with a keyboard.
fixed_by: The native file input is visible, labelled and described by its format and size instructions.

summary: Step 4 asks again for the email address already entered in step 3, without pre-filling it or offering to reuse it.
fixed_by: Step 4 shows the address entered in step 3 in the summary and does not ask for it again.

summary: The two buttons that decrease and increase the number of copies are 16 by 16 CSS pixels and sit 2 pixels from the text field.
fixed_by: The buttons are 44 by 44 CSS pixels with an 8 pixel gap.

summary: The "Aide et contact" link is in the header, before the main menu, on every other page, but at the top of the footer on this one.
fixed_by: The help link is in the header, before the main menu, on every page.

summary: The search button contains only a decorative SVG and has no accessible name.
fixed_by: The button contains the visually hidden text "Lancer la recherche".

summary: The result count updated after each search is a plain paragraph, not a live region: the number of results is not announced.
fixed_by: The paragraph has role="status"; focus stays in the search field.

summary: The search form has a minimum width of 40rem, so the page scrolls horizontally at a width of 320 CSS pixels.
fixed_by: The form has no minimum width; the field and the button wrap.

summary: The "Vous ne trouvez pas l’information ?" block is fixed to the bottom of the viewport and entirely covers links that receive keyboard focus behind it, for example the third result link when the page is tabbed through from the top in a 1280 by 700 pixel window.
fixed_by: The block is in the normal flow after the results; no element of the site is fixed or sticky.

summary: The lang attribute of the html element is "français", which is not a valid language code.
fixed_by: The html element has lang="fr".

summary: The three elements with role="tab" are not contained in an element with role="tablist": their container is a plain div without a name.
fixed_by: The container has role="tablist" and is named by the heading above it.

summary: The inactive tabs are removed from the tab order with tabindex="-1" but no arrow-key handling is provided: the "Contact" and "Stationnement" panels cannot be opened with a keyboard.
fixed_by: Left and Right arrows, Home and End move between tabs and activate them, following the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices tabs pattern.

summary: The opening hours table has two rows of column headers and one column of row headers, but none of its th elements has a scope attribute (or id/headers), so cells cannot be reliably associated with their headers.
fixed_by: Group headers have scope="colgroup", column headers scope="col" and row headers scope="row".

summary: The town-centre map is larger than its frame and can only be moved by dragging it with a pointer: there is no single-pointer alternative (the same element cannot be moved with a keyboard either, 2.1.1).
fixed_by: The frame is a native scrolling region with visible scrollbars, a region role, a name and tabindex="0".

summary: The buttons of the "Questions fréquentes" accordion show and hide their panel without exposing the expanded or collapsed state (no aria-expanded).
fixed_by: Each question is a native details element with a summary.

summary: A five-second sound clip starts on page load and loops, with no control to pause it, stop it or change its volume.
fixed_by: The audio element has native controls, does not start by itself and is preceded by a text description of the sound.

summary: The page has no title element.
fixed_by: The title names the page and the site.
